description: The Kansas City VA Medical Center is seeking to purchase (1) 8' Motorized Parallel Bars for their facility to assist in the rehabilitation of Veterans. This will include purchase, delivery, and installation. This is a Sources Sought Only and no Quotes will be accepted or evaluated at this time. Please email responses to Kelly Malec @ Kelly.Malec@VA.GOV NLT 05/08/2026 @ 04:00 PM CST with the requested informaiton (see document) if interested.
